subject.title: fix(amazon-bedrock): keep blank credentials from overriding AWS auth

question: Should the Bedrock plugins permanently delete whitespace-only AWS credential variables from the gateway process so the AWS SDK default chain can fall through for all Bedrock paths?
rationale: The dependency contract and proof support the fix, but only an owner can confirm that process-global environment normalization is the intended credential boundary for a multi-plugin gateway.

options.title: Accept Bedrock normalization
options.body: Merge the current private sanitizer design after updating the branch and rerunning exact-head checks, treating blank AWS values as globally unconfigured.

options.title: Require a narrower provider
options.body: Request Bedrock-specific credential-provider construction that avoids permanent process environment mutation if plugins should not change shared AWS variables.

options.title: Pause the fix
options.body: Leave current AWS SDK behavior unchanged and document that operators must remove blank credential variables themselves.

recommendation.title: Accept Bedrock normalization
recommendation.body: Merge the current private sanitizer design after updating the branch and rerunning exact-head checks, treating blank AWS values as globally unconfigured.

likelyOwner.reason: The history most directly ties this person to introducing Mantle IAM authentication and its credential-refresh behavior.
